applicant_utility.summary: This Fulbright-García Robles regional call is geography-locked: you must originate from and live in Mexico's interior outside CDMX, Guadalajara and Monterrey, and any US residence or nationality, including dual status, disqualifies you. The money is an unlabelled pot of up to USD 37,000 per school year (master's, up to 18 months) or USD 25,000 (doctorate, up to three years) that you allocate yourself across tuition, fees, books and living costs, so your budget discipline matters more than any stipend label. You cannot arrive with a US admission in hand: existing admission or a conditional offer tied to an English course both exclude you, because COMEXUS pays and tracks applications at up to five universities on your behalf. Mind the long runway: applications close 15 January 2027, but studies cannot start before August 2028 without exception.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Mexican nationals from interior states outside the three big metros, in STEM fields with strong grades (average 9/10) and an intermediate English level, who want the Commission to handle the US admission process.
application_readiness_checklist: Document origin and current residence in a state outside CDMX, Guadalajara and Monterrey (temporary moves there for postgraduate study still count as eligible).
Book TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo early so results are inside the published score bands and less than two years old when you apply.
Request the English graduation commitment letter from your university, stating completion no later than March 2028.
Alert your three recommenders in advance; letters are completed online and Spanish is accepted for this programme.
Compile tiras de materias for every degree; if studied outside Mexico, obtain official conversion of the average to the Mexican scale.
Keep the automatic confirmation email after clicking 'enviar solicitud' as proof that the application was received.
common_rejection_risks: Originating from or living in CDMX, Monterrey or Guadalajara and their conurbation areas.
Already holding a US university admission, or an offer conditioned on taking an English course.
US residence, US nationality or dual Mexican-US nationality; living, working or studying in the US; over one year of US residence in the past five years; a US bachelor's or master's.
English scores outside the bands (TOEFL iBT 61-79, IELTS Academic 5.0-6.5, Duolingo 95-110) or older than two years.
Being a former Fulbright-García Robles master's or PhD recipient.
Leaving the application incomplete and never clicking 'enviar solicitud', since COMEXUS disclaims responsibility for that step.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Anything beyond the unlabelled award, which may only be spent on maintenance per the State Department tabulator, tuition, fees and books: relocation beyond the transfers included in the English course, dependent expenses, and personal costs not covered by Fulbright ASPE insurance.
document_audit: Registrations from previous calls are deleted from the system, so create a new account at solicitudes.comexus.org.mx.
Recommendation letters are completed inside the online form, so give recommenders stable email access and advance notice.
If your tira de materias omits the average, add a separate average letter; foreign degrees need official conversion to the Mexican scale.
The graduation commitment letter must be in English and commit to a degree date no later than March 2028.
Applying in a field different from your previous degree requires an explicit justification in the essays.
Doctoral applicants must include a Spanish writing sample of up to 10,000 words.
alerts: Studies must begin in August 2028 without exception; if your timeline does not fit, this call is not for you.
Interview slots are fixed and cannot be changed, and the selection results are final (inapelables).
This award is mutually exclusive with the EducationUSA Opportunity Funds - if you are notified of both, you must choose one.

applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register at solicitudes.comexus.org.mx, complete the form with all documents and click 'enviar solicitud'; COMEXUS then pays and tracks admission applications at up to five universities, followed by expert-panel interviews (March-May 2027) and notifications in June 2027.
